title: Create profile macro and scene tests
description:
Create tests/ProfileMacroSceneTests.cpp and register it in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the serialized owner of CMakeLists.txt for the final wave of phase i.

Before editing, inspect:
- tests/ for the existing juce::UnitTest console-runner target and how earlier phase test files are registered in CMakeLists.txt; follow that exact pattern.
- Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h, ProfileManager.h, ProfileSnapshot.h, Source/Profiles/SceneManager.h, and Source/Parameters/MacroEngine.h for the interfaces under test.
- Resources/Profiles/*.json for the twelve bundled profiles.
Use the built-in juce::UnitTest framework only. Catch2, GoogleTest, and every other third-party framework are forbidden, and no new dependency may be added.

Write tests covering exactly these claims:
1. All twelve bundled profiles parse and validate with ok == true.
2. Every parameter ID referenced by every bundled profile exists in the frozen parameter layout.
3. A profile whose schema_version is 0 or kCurrentSchemaVersion + 1 is rejected.
4. Malformed profiles (non-object root, non-numeric delta, curve <= 0, three scenes, seven macros) fail safely: ok == false, non-empty errors, default document, no throw.
5. An unknown parameter ID follows the migration rule: dropped, migration note recorded, document still ok.
6. Profile loading performs no audio-thread IO: assert that ProfileManager exposes no processBlock-callable entry point by testing that a full load completes with the handoff generation unchanged until an explicit publish, and that acquire() on ProfileSnapshotHandoff returns a valid POD reference without any load having been triggered from it.
7. No artist, band, or song name appears in any shipped resource: scan the embedded BinaryData profile blobs for a denylist of name-shaped tokens and assert none are present, and assert every profile_name, description, and tag is present and non-empty.
8. Macro sweep: for each bundled profile and each of the eight macros, sweep u from 0.0 to 1.0 in 101 steps and assert every resulting effective destination value stays within that destination parameter's declared [min, max].
9. Macro movement does not rewrite destination APVTS values: capture every APVTS base value before the sweep and assert each is bit-identical afterwards.
10. Curve and endpoint mapping: assert delta(u=0) == deltaMin, delta(u=1) == deltaMax within 1e-6, and that curve 2.0 yields delta(u=0.5) equal to deltaMin + 0.25 * (deltaMax - deltaMin) within 1e-6.
11. Morph domains: assert a linear-domain destination at lambda = 0.5 equals the arithmetic mean of its endpoints within 1e-6, and that a strictly positive time/frequency destination at lambda = 0.5 equals std::sqrt(p_A * p_B) within 1e-5, proving logarithmic morphing rather than linear.
12. Discrete parameters switch under the crossfade: assert a routing target takes only its two endpoint values across the morph and never an intermediate value, and that the switch occurs within the 30 ms crossfade window.
13. Base macro values remain unchanged through scene morphs: capture the eight macro base APVTS values, run a full A-to-D morph, and assert every base value is bit-identical afterwards.

In CMakeLists.txt, add tests/ProfileMacroSceneTests.cpp to the existing test runner target's source list only. Change nothing else in CMakeLists.txt. Verify with cmake --build build --target ShredSpaceTests and ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure -R ProfileMacroScene.
